name: validation-upstream-eslint-plugin-react-hooks
description: eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1 as published, in the layout of facebook/react's own node_modules at the eslint-plugin-react-hooks@7.1.1 tag: eslint 7.32.0 at the root (@typescript-eslint/parser 3.x's experimental-utils extends its CLIEngine as it loads), the eslint-v7 and eslint-v9 aliases its tests run, their parsers, and the Babel packages of babel.config-ts.js, at the versions its yarn.lock resolves, except eslint-v9 (9.39.5, the latest ^9.0.0 admits, not the lock's 9.0.0).
